notes: DECISION: Instatus's colour mark is this outline 'S' filled with a cyan-to-blue gradient, but every published colour version paints the gradient as a bitmap: instatus.com/icon.svg and the header's inline svg (mask + <image> pattern) and the brand kit's rgb/cmyk logo.pdf (a 565x459 PNG inside); the kit has no SVG (ai/eps/pdf/png only). So the vector here is the monochrome mark, black in light mode and white in dark, as the kit's b&w logo and Instatus's own dashboard use it. instatus.com/logo.svg (BIMI tiny-ps, teal ringed planet on black) and github.com/instatushq/out-home svg/instatus-icon.svg are the retired 2021 mark, not used. simple-icons' instatus.svg and svgl's instatus/instatus_dark.svg are that retired planet mark too.
